The petition coming on for hearing, upon perusing the Petition and the  It-: affidavit filed in support thereof and upon hearing the arguments of SRI C  SUBODH, Advocate for the Petitioner, learned GP FOR MUNICIPAL  ADMINISTRATION AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT for the Respondent No.1,

2 tt The petitioner is aggrieved by the unilateral action of the 2"** respondent in demolishing the compound wall of the petitioner and further proposal to lay a road over the petitioner's land without resorting to the provisions of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition and Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
It is submitted that the petitioner has purchased the property vide registered sale deed dated 14.02.2011 and thereafter has been in possession and enjoyment of the same.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition and Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It is submitted that the 2"'* respondent authorities have deployed JCB and demolished the compound wall of the petitioner and also marked about seven feet from the road margin as land required for widening of the road.

It is submitted that the petitioner is not coming in the way of developmental activity of the 2"'*
respondent.

However, the 2"*^ respondent is required to lay a road by taking over the property of the petitioner and the said process would have to be in accordance with law and the petitioner would have adequately compensate the amount as per the provisions of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition and Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition and Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: nd The learned standing counsel for 2 respondent on written instructions submits that the said compound wall was situated in a low- lying area and it was recently affected by heavy rains and flooding.
Due to continuous water stagnation and soil erosion, the wall had developed cracks and considering imminent threat and safety of the public the corporation finally demolished the compound wall.

Considering the same, there is no correlation between the instructions submitted by the learned standing counsel for the 2"*^ m respondent and the photographs filed by the petitioner along with the writ petition.
I-- Ml There shall be a direction to the 2"'* respondent not to take over the petitioner's property for the purpose of laying road without following the due process of law.
For filing counter, post the matter on 28.11.2025.
